expectation: Membrane-ring stain on a subset of immune cells (B cells, DCs, macrophages/monocytes) plus FDC and endothelium or epithelium. It should be patchy, concentrated in lymphoid aggregates or follicles and myeloid-rich zones, partly on CD14 cells, and sparse elsewhere.
observed: A: bright yellow patches confined to a few ROIs (dense clusters in ROIs 3, 8 and 9), while others are dim and B/C are nearly empty. D: cell-outline membrane networks in a dense aggregate. E: patchy CD40 partly overlapping CD14 (white), with green-only clusters; E1 has some diffuse texture.
why: CD40 is confined to discrete aggregate-like regions with membrane-pattern cells and partial CD14 overlap; it is not uniform haze.
